{{Quote|I know the one Harrar sent. He apprenticed under the Shai.|Elan|<ref name="AOC:HC" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''assassin''' who was apprenticed under [[Domain Shai]] was sent by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harrar]] to attack the defector [[Elan]] as a means of convincing the [[New Republic]] of the authenticity of Elan's actions. He assaulted the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] safehouse in [[New Nystao]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] as part of a Yuuzhan Vong [[Raid on Wayland (25 ABY)|raid]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] fought his way towards Elan, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] before he could complete his objective of slaying Elan.<ref name="AOC:HC" />
